lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਧਨ ਸੇਜੈ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: merai ka(n)t na bhaavai cholaRaa piaare kiu dhan sejai jaae ||1||
lines.translation: My Husband Lord is not pleased by these clothes, O Beloved; how can the soul-bride go to His bed? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n)u kurabaanai jaau miharavaanaa ha(n)u kurabaanai jaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, O Dear Merciful Lord; I am a sacrifice to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਲੈਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n)u kurabaanai jaau tinaa kai lain jo teraa naau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who take to Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੈਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਹੰਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: lain jo teraa naau tinaa kai ha(n)u sad kurabaanai jaau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Unto those who take to Your Name, I am forever a sacrifice. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਰੰਙਣਿ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਉ ਮਜੀਠ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa ra(n)ngan je theeai piaare paaeeai naau majeeth ||
lines.translation: If the body becomes the dyer's vat, O Beloved, and the Name is placed within it as the dye,

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਙਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਜੇ ਰੰਙੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਐਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਡੀਠ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)ngan vaalaa je ra(n)ngai saahib aisaa ra(n)g na deeth ||2||
lines.translation: and if the Dyer who dyes this cloth is the Lord Master - O, such a color has never been seen before! ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚੋਲੇ ਰਤੜੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੰਤੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ke chole rataRe piaare ka(n)t tinaa kai paas ||
lines.translation: Those whose shawls are so dyed, O Beloved, their Husband Lord is always with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੀ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੀ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dhooR tinaa kee je milai jee kahu naanak kee aradaas ||3||
lines.translation: Bless me with the dust of those humble beings, O Dear Lord. Says Nanak, this is my prayer. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape saaje aape ra(n)ge aape nadar karei ||
lines.translation: He Himself creates, and He Himself imbues us. He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਵੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman ka(n)tai bhaavai aape hee raavei ||4||1||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if the soul-bride becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord, He Himself enjoys her. ||4||1||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: tila(n)g mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Tilang, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਆਨੜੀਏ ਮਾਨੜਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: iaanaReee maanaRaa kaai karehi ||
lines.translation: O foolish and ignorant soul-bride, why are you so proud?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੋ ਕੀ ਨ ਮਾਣੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaRai ghar har ra(n)go kee na maanehi ||
lines.translation: Within the home of your own self, why do you not enjoy the Love of your Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਧਨ ਕੰਮਲੀਏ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahu neRai dhan ka(n)maleee baahar kiaa dhoodhehi ||
lines.translation: Your Husband Lord is so very near, O foolish bride; why do you search for Him outside?

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਕੀਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਸਲਾਈਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਭਾਵ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai keeaa dehi salaaeeaa nainee bhaav kaa kar seegaaro ||
lines.translation: Apply the Fear of God as the maascara to adorn your eyes, and make the Love of the Lord your ornament.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਲਾਗੀ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taa sohaagan jaaneeai laagee jaa sahu dhare piaaro ||1||
lines.translation: Then, you shall be known as a devoted and committed soul-bride, when you enshrine love for your Husband Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਆਣੀ ਬਾਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: iaanee baalee kiaa kare jaa dhan ka(n)t na bhaavai ||
lines.translation: What can the silly young bride do, if she is not pleasing to her Husband Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan palaah kare bahutere saa dhan mahal na paavai ||
lines.translation: She may plead and implore so many times, but still, such a bride shall not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin karamaa kichh paaeeai naahee je bahuteraa dhaavai ||
lines.translation: Without the karma of good deeds, nothing is obtained, although she may run around frantically.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਬ ਲੋਭ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਕੀ ਮਾਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: lab lobh aha(n)kaar kee maatee maaiaa maahi samaanee ||
lines.translation: She is intoxicated with greed, pride and egotism, and engrossed in Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਇਆਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: inee baatee sahu paaeeai naahee bhaee kaaman iaanee ||2||
lines.translation: She cannot obtain her Husband Lord in these ways; the young bride is so foolish! ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਵਾਹੈ ਕਿਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaai puchhahu sohaaganee vaahai kinee baatee sahu paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Go and ask the happy, pure soul-brides, how did they obtain their Husband Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kare so bhalaa kar maaneeai hikamat hukam chukaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Whatever the Lord does, accept that as good; do away with your own cleverness and self-will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਉ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai prem padaarath paaeeai tau charanee chit laaeeai ||
lines.translation: By His Love, true wealth is obtained; link your consciousness to His lotus feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੋ ਦੀਜੈ ਐਸਾ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahu kahai so keejai tan mano deejai aisaa paramal laaeeai ||
lines.translation: As your Husband Lord directs, so you must act; surrender your body and mind to Him, and apply this perfume to yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਵ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭੈਣੇ ਇਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ev kahahi sohaaganee bhaine inee baatee sahu paaeeai ||3||
lines.translation: So speaks the happy soul-bride, O sister; in this way, the Husband Lord is obtained. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਉਰੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap gavaaeeai taa sahu paaeeai aur kaisee chaturaaee ||
lines.translation: Give up your selfhood, and so obtain your Husband Lord; what other clever tricks are of any use?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahu nadar kar dekhai so din lekhai kaaman nau nidh paaee ||
lines.translation: When the Husband Lord looks upon the soul-bride with His Gracious Glance, that day is historic - the bride obtains the nine treasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapane ka(n)t piaaree saa sohaagan naanak saa sabharaaee ||
lines.translation: She who is loved by her Husband Lord, is the true soul-bride; O Nanak, she is the queen of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਮਾਤੀ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਾਇ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisai ra(n)g raatee sahaj kee maatee ahinis bhaai samaanee ||
lines.translation: Thus she is imbued with His Love, intoxicated with delight; day and night, she is absorbed in His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਇ ਸਰੂਪ ਬਿਚਖਣਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਾ ਸਿਆਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)dar saai saroop bichakhan kaheeai saa siaanee ||4||2||4||
lines.translation: She is beautiful, glorious and brilliant; she is known as truly wise. ||4||2||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Tilang, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੈਸੜਾ ਕਰੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisee mai aavai khasam kee baanee taisaRaa karee giaan ve laalo ||
lines.translation: As the Word of the Forgiving Lord comes to me, so do I express it, O Lalo.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕੀ ਜੰਞ ਲੈ ਕਾਬਲਹੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਜੋਰੀ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: paap kee ja(n)nj lai kaabalahu dhaaiaa joree ma(n)gai daan ve laalo ||
lines.translation: Bringing the marriage party of sin, Babar has invaded from Kaabul, demanding our land as his wedding gift, O Lalo.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਇ ਛਪਿ ਖਲੋਏ ਕੂੜੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: saram dharam dui chhap khaloe kooR phirai paradhaan ve laalo ||
lines.translation: Modesty and righteousness both have vanished, and falsehood struts around like a leader, O Lalo.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀਆ ਬਾਮਣਾ ਕੀ ਗਲ ਥਕੀ ਅਗਦੁ ਪੜੈ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaajeeaa baamanaa kee gal thakee agad paRai saitaan ve laalo ||
lines.translation: The Qazis and the Brahmins have lost their roles, and Satan now conducts the marriage rites, O Lalo.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨੀਆ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਕਸਟ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: musalamaaneeaa paRahi katebaa kasat mahi karahi khudaai ve laalo ||
lines.translation: The Muslim women read the Koran, and in their misery, they call upon God, O Lalo.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਹਿਦਵਾਣੀਆ ਏਹਿ ਭੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaat sanaatee hor hidavaaneeaa ehi bhee lekhai laai ve laalo ||
lines.translation: The Hindu women of high social status, and others of lowly status as well, are put into the same category, O Lalo.
